uses.name: Digestion & gut comfort
uses.on_site_phrase: Sea moss is a natural source of soothing mucilage and prebiotic fiber; these herbs are traditionally used for comfortable digestion.
uses.wording_rules: Never name IBS / IBD / GERD as things the blend addresses.

uses.name: Skin, hair & nails
uses.on_site_phrase: Sea moss delivers sea minerals; these herbs are traditionally used for hair, skin and nails.
uses.wording_rules: No regrowth / follicle / thickening language — use the cosmetic-safe swap table.

uses.name: Energy & stamina
uses.on_site_phrase: Sea moss is traditionally taken for daily energy; these herbs add stamina.
uses.wording_rules: STIM / CAFFEINE flag → no-stim variant: maca:10,beet-root:8,moringa:6

uses.name: Vitality & drive (men)
uses.on_site_phrase: A Caribbean tradition — sea moss with herbs traditionally used for male vitality.
uses.wording_rules: Never 'sexual power', 'libido booster', 'testosterone'. Never in paid ads. Site wording: 'vitality and drive'.
